licenses.text:
Η Καινή Διαθήκη, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/grctr/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/grctr/copyright.htm):
> The Greek Textus Receptus New Testament with manuscript annotations by Adam Boyd
> Public Domain
> Language: Ελληνικά (Greek, Ancient)
> Manuscript comparison footnotes dedicated to the Public Domain by Adam Boyd. The Greek Textus Receptus New Testament is firmly in the Public Domain due to its age.
> 2026-10-13

What was found:
Text: a Textus Receptus compiled by Robert Adam Boyd (living, 2022) from the editions of Stephanus (1550), the Elzevirs (1624) and Scrivener (1881), with his footnotes.

Why it is admitted: Admitted as an exception on the maintainer's decision alone (2026-10-21): the only public-domain statement for Robert Adam Boyd's changes is eBible.org's label, and eBible.org is not Boyd's project; the same exception covers his three editions on eBible.org (engasvbt, englxxup, grctr).

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=grctr), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/grctr/copyright.htm), https://ebible.org/details.php?id=grctr.
